categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in cloud computing services, intelligent computing cloud (智算云), data center (IDC) services, and integrated cloud-network solutions. It serves industries including large model and AIGC applications, government, finance, education, media, and internet sectors. The business is structured around three main segments: intelligent computing cloud, computing cloud, and IDC services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes-based container orchestration, and hybrid scheduling engines for intelligent computing cloud services. It utilizes GPU virtualization, heterogeneous computing architectures (including NVIDIA MIG, AMD CDNA2), and high-performance vector databases with NVMe over Fabrics and RDMA acceleration. The computing cloud platform is self-developed with global resource management capabilities, supporting multi-cloud and hybrid cloud deployments. Advanced technologies include super heterogeneous computing, in-storage computing, AI inference optimization, and automated operation and maintenance platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises in large model and AIGC application sectors, internet companies, media, finance, education, and government agencies. The company also serves e-commerce, gaming, and online education industries. Its customer base spans both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, particularly North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with data centers and cloud nodes across China (notably Beijing, Gansu, Hainan, Hebei, Anhui), North America (including Dallas), Europe, South America (including Brazil), and Asia-Pacific regions such as Singapore and Hong Kong. It maintains a global private network covering over 50 countries and regions, enabling low-latency, high-reliability cloud and network services worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cloud computing and data center supply chain. It owns and operates data centers, procures communication resources (bandwidth, IP, cabinets) from upstream telecom operators, and provides cloud infrastructure and services directly to end customers. It also collaborates with third-party data center providers and chip manufacturers to optimize resource utilization and technology integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on intelligent computing transformation, expanding intelligent computing cloud services, and integrating AI capabilities into cloud platforms. R&D priorities include developing full-stack intelligent cloud products (IaaS, PaaS, MaaS), distributed inference platforms, heterogeneous computing adaptation, and global network optimization. The company invests heavily in AI infrastructure platforms, container cloud technologies, and supports domestic GPU chip ecosystems. It also emphasizes green computing technologies such as liquid cooling and energy reuse.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales and service fees for cloud computing resources, IDC services (cabinet and bandwidth rental), and value-added services. The company uses a pay-as-you-go model for cloud services, charging customers based on actual resource usage. It also earns revenue from long-term contracts and direct sales to enterprise customers, with a focus on B2B sales via offline direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the cloud computing and IDC industry against major domestic and international cloud service providers. It positions itself as a technology-driven, AI-enabled cloud and data center service provider with a strong focus on intelligent computing and AI integration. Its competitive advantages include proprietary global network infrastructure, heterogeneous computing capabilities, and tailored solutions for AI and large model customers. The company faces intense competition but leverages innovation and strategic partnerships to enhance market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.4 billion, representing a 12.35% year-over-year growth. Despite continuous losses over recent years, net losses narrowed slightly in 2024. The company has total assets nearing RMB 2 billion and net assets around RMB 931 million. It has sustained steady revenue growth driven by intelligent computing cloud services, which grew 184% in 2024 and now account for 13% of revenue. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and infrastructure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated cloud-network platform with global reach, high-performance heterogeneous computing, and AI-optimized cloud services. Its intelligent computing cloud products offer microsecond-level scheduling, high GPU utilization, and support for diverse AI frameworks and chip architectures. The company provides differentiated solutions tailored to large model and AIGC applications, with strong capabilities in distributed AI training and inference. Its value proposition includes reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure combined with specialized AI services and global low-latency network connectivity.
